description: Write one to three social post drafts for the business the account selects, for one platform (instagram, facebook, google_business, x or tiktok), from what the business approved on OnHand: the services it added (never ones read from its website) with their listed prices, the owner's own FAQs, upcoming events the owner confirmed, its description and city. topic (service, faq, event or about) and item_id (a service_id or faq_id from get_owner_content) narrow it; an item_id OnHand can't write about answers no_facts; count is 1 to 3 (default 3). Each draft has text within the platform's limit, hashtags, image_idea and written_by (model or template). Drafts never claim stock, openings, discounts or prices the owner didn't list, and carry no links or contact details. Nothing is posted or saved: show the drafts and let the owner post one themselves. Live and Pro. Requires company:read; the account selects the business.
name: draft_social_post
title: Draft social posts
